name: Document Number 5 Choice
definition: Choice between a short document number, a long document number or a proprietary document number.

ShortNumber.name: Short Number
ShortNumber.definition: Message type number of the document referenced.

LongNumber.name: Long Number
LongNumber.definition: MX Message identifier of the referenced document.

ShortLongNumberRule.definition: ShortNumber must contain the FIN message type number of the linked message. LongNumber must contain the XML message identifier of the linked message.
